name: Omantigravity
author: asdfsnlr
description: Real-time Antigravity CLI quota limits, 5-hour and weekly window meters, and reset countdowns for Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Monitor Antigravity CLI quota limits, 5-hour & weekly reset countdowns.

schema.label: Antigravity CLI (agy) path
schema.description: Full path to your installed agy binary (e.g. ~/.local/share/mise/shims/agy). Required -- for your safety this plugin never guesses or auto-discovers it.

schema.label: Poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to check for quota updates in background (default 300s).

schema.label: Show percentage in bar
schema.description: Display remaining quota percentage next to the icon in the bar.

schema.label: Bar metric
schema.description: Which quota limit percentage to show in the bar.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Nerd Font icon glyph for the bar button.

schema.label: Alert threshold (%)
schema.description: Notify when remaining quota falls to or below this percentage.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Send desktop notification when quota reaches alert threshold.

schema.label: Active network health check
schema.description: Perform ICMP ping and HTTPS TTFB latency measurements to Google servers (disabled by default to prevent unsolicited network traffic).
